sources.title: 2026 Kentucky Withholding Tax Tables — Computer Formula 42A003 (TCF)

residencyAndWorkRules.residentRule: Kentucky requires withholding for resident wages unless an exemption applies; work-state obligations and credits require separate multi-state handling.
residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentRule: Nonresident wages are subject to Kentucky withholding to the extent paid for Kentucky services unless a reciprocal-state or other statutory exemption is documented.

reciprocityConditions.IL_IN_MI_WV_WI: Employee resides in the reciprocal state and did not reside in Kentucky during the taxable year.
reciprocityConditions.VA: Employee resides in Virginia and commutes daily to the Kentucky workplace.
reciprocityConditions.OH: Employee is not a shareholder-employee owning directly or indirectly 20% or more of an S corporation.

filing.twiceMonthlyDuePattern: Days 1-15 due the 25th; days 16-end due the 10th of the next month, subject to year-end rules.

localWithholding.administration: Kentucky DOR does not administer city, county, or other local occupational and license taxes.

captureWarnings: The official biweekly example is internally inconsistent: it first computes $35,640 taxable wages, then uses $35,730 in the next line; $1,247.40 corresponds to $35,640 at 3.5%. The published $47 periodic result is whole-dollar and does not equal the exact unrounded quotient.
The 2026 formula publication does not state a general rounding sequence or a separately stated supplemental-wage method.
Only upper wage-table rules are transcribed; complete daily, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, and monthly matrices remain in the checksummed publication.
Kentucky local occupational taxes are a separate, potentially residence-and-work-dependent subsystem and must not be inferred from the state formula.

review.requiredNextStep: Resolve the official biweekly example discrepancy and rounding, capture supplemental wages and all table matrices, implement conditional reciprocity and Kentucky local occupational-tax selection, and add executable regression tests before activation.
